Daily Devotional

October 5

7 For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it? (1 Corinthians 4:7 KJV)

People who are walking in pride, and brag on all their accomplishments, are fooling themselves, as God is the one that gives us our abilities and blessings, and He should be the one we are giving glory to. After all, God could have made us just a little different, by changing our brains or bodies, and making us unable to do anything at all. People who are sold on themselves and are suffering from pride, will soon come to a fall (Proverbs 16:18).

I believe that pride is one of the worst faults that a person can have, as it is actually making a God out of yourself, and as you worship yourself, you are worshiping yourself as an idol. Being self centered, whether it is thinking more highly of yourself than you should, or whether you are shy, is placing all your concern and thoughts on yourself, and leaves no room for worshiping God. Be humble, and keep your mind on God and live for Him, so you will prosper in this life and the next life. Jesus rebuked the religious Jews for their pride, but was forgiving to the sinners (Matthew 13). This shows us that He thought their self-righteousness was a worse sin than any of the other sins. Learn from the bible, and know that having a humble heart, and putting others as being more important than yourself, is how Jesus would have us to be, as that is the way that He is (Matthew 11:29). Thank you Lord for your Word.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
